subject: Post-call: buying path & next steps (MedLytics) - ownership & contract routing
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@medlytics.com>, Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@medlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T15:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: buying path & next steps (MedLytics) - ownership & contract routing

Hi Samir / Rachel — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed owners so we keep momentum: 

1) Economic buyer and decision criteria
- Rachel (CFO) is the economic buyer; primary evaluation criteria are predictable unit cost, data residency guarantees, and SLA for latency under peak.

2) Procurement / Legal / Security lanes (who owns what) — proposed:
- NDA & initial legal hold: Ben Carter (Contracts) — Redwood will send our template and accept quick redlines.
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence: Neha Kapoor (Security & Compliance) — will own Q&A and provide evidence bundle.
- PO / procurement terms and pricing handshake: Priyom Das (Sales Ops) — will coordinate quote and procurement cadence.

3) Contract sequencing and target turn times (proposed)
- NDA: 48 business hours once legal engages
- DPA: run in parallel with NDA, 3–5 business days for first pass
- MSA (commercial terms): 5–10 business days depending on redlines; we propose canary clause for pilot to shorten timeline

4) Next steps (action items):
- Redwood: send NDA template and the sample DPA + HubSpot deal link (Ben) — target EOD 9/8. [Attachment: Redwood_NDA-template_v3.pdf]
- MedLytics: confirm internal legal reviewer and expected turnaround (Samir/Rachel) — please confirm by 9/9.
- Security: Neha will schedule a 30-min sync to walk through classifiers & SOC2 artifacts — proposed 9/10 or 9/11.
- Sales Ops: Priyom will prepare a 90-day pilot commercial that contains pricing and PO terms.

I've attached the RFP you shared to this thread for quick reference. If this owner mapping looks right, Ben/Neha/Priyom — please confirm and I'll mark in the HubSpot timeline.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: MedLytics_RFP.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@medlytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@medlytics.com>
Cc: MedLytics Legal <legal@medlytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: buying path & next steps (MedLytics) - ownership & contract routing

Thanks Ava — that summary is spot on. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming Rachel (CFO) as economic buyer. She also wants a short one-pager comparing TCO across pilot vs. full deployment (Priyom, can your team produce?).
- Legal: I looped in our in-house counsel (legal@medlytics.com). They'll prioritize the NDA — expect an initial read in ~2 business days and redlines in 3–5 business days depending on conflict with our standard procurement clauses.
- Security: Our security lead (cc'd on later threads) will own the SOC2 review; they typically ask for a SPIRE report plus sample sysadmin access plan. I'll attach our internal risk profile for context.

We appreciate the proposed sequencing; NDA first makes sense to get confidentiality in place. We'll aim to return the redlines quickly. 

Samir
Director, Partnerships | MedLytics
samir.shah@medlytics.com | (617) 555-3456

[Attachment: MedLytics_RiskProfile.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call: buying path & next steps (MedLytics) - ownership & contract routing

Folks — copying the external note below for context. Proposed contract routing and internal checklist: 

Quoted: 
> "Legal: I looped in our in-house counsel (legal@medlytics.com). They'll prioritize the NDA — expect an initial read in ~2 business days..." — Samir

Routing plan (internal owners):
- NDA (initial confidentiality): Owner = Ben Carter (Contracts). Action: send Redwood_NDA-template_v3.pdf; request tracked redlines in a shared DocuSign draft. Target: 48 business hours after legal acknowledgement.
- DPA (data processing): Owner = Neha Kapoor (Security). Action: provide baseline DPA + suggested privacy appendix; allow parallel review with NDA to avoid blocking. Target: 3–5 business days first pass.
- MSA (commercial): Owner = Ava Chen + Ben Carter. Action: run commercial redlines after DPA alignment; propose clause-level exceptions only during pilot. Target: 7 business days typical, escalate to 3 if needed for pilot launch.

Escalation & tracking:
- Create HubSpot task with due dates and link to DocuSign template.
- If MedLytics' counsel requires more than 10 business days for MSA redlines, schedule an executive check-in with Rachel (CFO) to surface blockers.

Attachments I'll add to the HubSpot deal: Redwood_NDA-template_v3.pdf, sample DPA (link), and the DocuSign NDA template. I also recommend we include a note about our usual turn-times in the DocuSign message so the customer knows expectations up front.

Ben Carter
Sr. Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

[Attachment: Redwood_NDA-template_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@medlytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call: buying path & next steps (MedLytics) - ownership & contract routing

Confirming I'll own the security lane. Plan from my side: 

1) Send over the SOC2 evidence index and access expectations by 9/10 morning (SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx).
2) Schedule a 30-min technical sync with MedLytics security (please propose slots 9/10 or 9/11).
3) DPA approach: we'll provide a baseline + privacy appendix; propose limited edits where necessary. If they have new language around data residency, we'll mark as high-priority.

Ben — I'll prepare a short memo on likely DPA hotspots (data sub-processing, deletion SLA, and audit rights) and add to the HubSpot deal. Priyom — please hold off on issuing the pilot PO until we have NDA acknowledged.

Thanks — Neha
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (xlsx)]
